_note: Synthetic statements in the style of real bank exports (Chase checking CSV, Amex card CSV, a German Volksbank-style CSV, a credit-union CSV with preamble lines, OFX 1.02 SGML, QFX credit card, OFX 2.1.1 XML, and a minimal PDF). Shapes follow the OFX 1.0.2/2.1.1 specs and the banks' documented CSV layouts. No real names or account numbers; at most 4 account digits visible. Re-record from real (redacted) exports when available. camt.053 files (001.02 German style; 001.08 Swiss multi-currency + UK) use the published example IBANs from ECBS/SIX. US bank CSV presets (Chase card, Bank of America checking/card, Wells Fargo, Citi, Capital One card/360, U.S. Bank, PNC, Mercury, Apple Card, Discover) follow each bank's documented column headers with made-up merchants and amounts. Apple Card and Discover headers and signs come from importer documentation (TidBITS, beancount.io), not the issuers: neither publishes its CSV columns.
